name: Saginomiya Arika
source:
One of the nobles who holds absolute power on the island. The protagonist of this story. A haughty and arrogant young lady. On the day of the entrance ceremony, she falls in love with Hanami at first sight and devises schemes to win her over.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110916022645/http://angelblack.jp/doreijima1.html]official website[/url]]
